# nuthatch nest on mainnet

A self-hosted blockchain index. Query it locally; there is no third-party API.

## Contracts
- `fiat_token_v2_2` = 0x1abaea1f7c830bd89acc67ec4af516284b1bc33c

## Tables (one per contract event, plus any `[extract]` table)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__approval` - Approval(address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, owner, spender, value)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__authorization_canceled` - AuthorizationCanceled(address,bytes32) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, authorizer, nonce)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__authorization_used` - AuthorizationUsed(address,bytes32) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, authorizer, nonce)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__blacklisted` - Blacklisted(address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, _account)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__blacklister_changed` - BlacklisterChanged(address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, newBlacklister)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__burn` - Burn(address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, burner, amount)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__master_minter_changed` - MasterMinterChanged(address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, newMasterMinter)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__mint` - Mint(address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, minter, to, amount)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__minter_configured` - MinterConfigured(address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, minter, minterAllowedAmount)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__minter_removed` - MinterRemoved(address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, oldMinter)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__ownership_transferred` - OwnershipTransferred(address,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, previousOwner, newOwner)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__pause` - Pause() (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__pauser_changed` - PauserChanged(address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, newAddress)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__rescuer_changed` - RescuerChanged(address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, newRescuer)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__transfer` - Transfer(address,address,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, from, to, value)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__un_blacklisted` - UnBlacklisted(address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, _account)
- `fiat_token_v2_2__unpause` - Unpause() (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq)

## SQL types
- `uint`/`int` columns wider than 64 bits are exact decimal text: never `SUM` the raw column.
  `<col>_dec` is the value as `DECIMAL(38,0)`, NULL when it does not fit (`<col>_overflow` is
  then true). Ids, nonces and hashes stay on the raw column.
- `bool` columns are text `'true'`/`'false'`: write `col = 'true'` or `CAST(col AS BOOLEAN)`.
- Reserved-word columns such as `"from"` and `"to"` must be double-quoted.
- Call the MCP `schema` tool first: it lists the `_dec`, bool and reserved columns.

## Live HTTP API (run `nuthatch dev`)
- `GET /`                    index status
- `GET /tables`              every table with its columns
- `GET /table/{name}?limit=N` recent rows of one table (hot + sealed)
- `GET /entity/{id}`         one row by id (`{block:012}-{logindex:06}`)
- `GET /sql?q=SELECT...`     read-only SQL; each table is a view named `{alias}__{event}`, and each
                             authored view (`views/*.sql`) answers by its own name
- `GET /balances?limit=N`    top balances: net flow since `start_block`, holders only when `GET /` says `history_from_deployment: true` (false or null means net flow)
- `GET /balance/{address}`   one address's derived balance, on the same condition. That flag means indexed from the configured `start_block` with no `--backfill`: the deployment only if `start_block` is the deployment block, which `init` sets
- `GET /queries`             the mount's SQL mode and the queries its operator declared in
                             `mounts.toml` (none on an open nest); `GET /q/{name}` runs one
- `GET /derived`             the nest's incremental entities (`entities.toml`); `GET /derived/{entity}` reads one
- `GET /diff?from=X&to=Y`    what happened in a range (`block=N`, or `tx=0x..&block=N`), as JSON, `format=text` or `markdown`

## MCP (for coding agents)
Run `nuthatch mcp` (stdio) to expose tools: status, schema, tables, table, sql, explain, entity, diff, balance, top_balances.
Fully offline against the local instance; nothing phones home.
